project.title: Babylon, approximately 570 BCE | Schematic Pipeline Starter
project.description: A training project that demonstrates the ArchaeoForge evidence controls and procedural scene compiler. Coordinates, residential blocks, wall lines, palace massing, river alignment, and unsupported upper dimensions are schematic until replaced with georeferenced archaeological data and reviewed claims.
project.origin_note: Local schematic origin. +X east, +Y north, +Z up.
